newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee trading above 35.70-mark against dlr.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee trading above 35.70-mark against dlr.

text.p: The Indian rupee was trading at 35.6950 against the dollar on Tuesday afternoon compared to 35.70 in the morning session, dealers said.
"The RBI (Reserve Bank of India) is not in the market - passively or actively," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said they expected the central bank to buy dollars to arrest the rupee's rise later in the day.
The RBI has been 'passively' intervening -- buying dollars from banks approaching it -- in recent weeks, they said.
